references.text: The expression 'your eye shall not spare' is also used here to mean carrying out punishment without mercy, the same wording as in Deut 25:12.
The principle of retribution and punishment without mercy - 'your eye shall show no pity' - is repeated in this context regarding righteous judgment.
The same expression 'your eye shall not spare' is used to mean showing no mercy when God's judgment is to be executed.
The lex talionis principle of physical punishment corresponding to the harm caused underlies the punishment described in Deut 25:12.
The law of retribution describing punishment matching the harm - the basis for the severe penalty in Deut 25:12.
Jesus refers to cutting off body parts that cause sin, which can be seen as a New Testament application of the radical principle of removing what causes harm.
